_comment: Phase 94a rollback config (24 May 2026) — restores bundled mode (Phase 88.2 baseline). To use: copy this file's contents over capacitor.config.json, then run `npx cap sync android` + rebuild APK + bump versionCode. Bundled mode ships JS on-device for 5-10x faster app open at the cost of needing an APK rebuild per JS change.
